system.description:
When you speak, people listen. A good voice and self-confidence lend a powerful presence, letting you motivate people, command attention and get them to follow your guidance even among those who neither know nor respect you.

Use Leadership with a Social Challenge to get a minor favor or task from a character. Leadership is also used with many powers of the Presence Discipline.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
